output.title: Is there a fee to file an appeal?
output.draft_text:
Question: Is there a fee to file an appeal?

Answer: [State whether there is a fee to file an appeal: "There is no fee to file an appeal" OR "The fee to file an appeal is [fee amount]"].

[If a fee applies, include the following:]
- The fee applies to [type(s) of appeal the fee applies to, e.g., internal appeal, external review].
- You can pay the fee by [accepted payment methods].
- The fee is due [when the fee is due].
- The fee [is / is not] refunded if the appeal decision is in your favor. [Refund conditions, if any].
- If you cannot afford the fee, [fee waiver or hardship process, if any].

[If different types of appeals have different fee rules, list each:]
- [Appeal type 1]: [fee or no fee]
- [Appeal type 2]: [fee or no fee]

To start an appeal, [how to file an appeal, or a link to the approved unit on filing an appeal]. You must file within [number of days] days of [triggering event, e.g., the date on the denial notice].

If you have questions about your appeal, contact [contact method and hours].
placeholders: [State whether there is a fee to file an appeal]
[type(s) of appeal the fee applies to]
[fee waiver or hardship process, if any]
[Appeal type 1] / [Appeal type 2] and their fee rules
[how to file an appeal, or a link to the approved unit on filing an appeal]
author_checklist: Confirm from the governing plan documents or policy whether any fee applies to filing an appeal; do not assume either way.
Confirm whether fee rules differ by appeal type or level (e.g., first-level internal appeal, second-level appeal, external/independent review) and by plan, product, or state.
If a fee exists, confirm the exact amount, payment methods, due date, refund conditions, and any waiver or hardship process.
Confirm the appeal filing deadline and the event that starts it.
Confirm the correct contact method, hours, and how-to-file instructions, or link to an existing approved unit if one is created.
Confirm whether this unit belongs in the benefits KB or whether pharmacy appeals (e.g., formulary or prior-authorization denials) need a separate or cross-linked unit.
Have the content reviewed by compliance/legal for regulatory accuracy before approval.
Remove all unused bracketed sections and placeholders before publishing.
